presets.name: Photo Realism (Qwen-Image)
presets.prompt: A photorealistic RAW photograph shot with a professional camera: natural lighting, realistic skin and surface textures, sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, muted natural colors.
presets.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted text, misspelled text, watermark, deformed hands

presets.name: Poster with Text (Qwen-Image)
presets.prompt: A modern graphic poster: bold clean typography with the title text rendered sharply and spelled exactly, strong layout grid, flat vivid colors, high-contrast print design.
presets.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted text, misspelled text, watermark, deformed hands

presets.name: Watercolor Art (Qwen-Image)
presets.prompt: Watercolor painting: soft translucent washes, visible paper texture, gently bleeding pigments, delicate brushwork, airy pastel palette.
presets.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted text, misspelled text, watermark, deformed hands
